note: Refinement to item 1 from the #2322 binding reconciler's own residual guidance — PREFER THIS over the body's weaker suggestion. The body proposes min(age_from_updatedAt, age_from_mtime) using the STATE-FILE mtime. The reconciler's sharper form: (a) add the PER-JOB logFile mtime as a liveness FLOOR in _job_age_s, and (b) hold the existing repo-keyed advisory dispatch lock .claude/cache/codex-dispatch.lock across the recheck+kill window.
